verdict.rationale: Lium documents root access and Docker-in-Docker on every pod, so a developer can run their own Docker image inside a rented pod. The phrase "default templates" implies a template system exists, but nothing shows that users can supply their own image as the pod base or create a custom template. missing for 10: documented support for a custom/BYO Docker image as the pod image, user-created machine templates, template management via CLI/API, independent corroboration.
